title: Blueberries
body:
"Blueberries are small, round berries with a deep blue color and a sweet-tart flavor."

Description

Blueberries is a item that can be found on bushes in the spawn area.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $100 per Blueberries. In its jam form it may be sold for $400.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.18% per bunch of blueberries.
